# Khuong Nguyen Huu — Senior Front-end Engineer

> Official portfolio and professional profile for Khuong Nguyen Huu, a Senior Front-end Engineer based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam.

## Summary

Khuong Nguyen Huu is a Senior Front-end Engineer with over 8 years of experience building enterprise web applications. His work focuses on frontend architecture, reusable components, responsive and cross-browser interfaces, feature delivery, code review and technical mentoring. Primary technologies include Angular, Vue.js and TypeScript.

## Portfolio sections

- [About](https://khuongnh-portfolio.vercel.app/#about): professional summary, experience metrics and employment history.
- [Career timeline](https://khuongnh-portfolio.vercel.app/#timeline): education and frontend engineering milestones from HUTECH University through FPT Software and ORIENT Software.
- [Selected work](https://khuongnh-portfolio.vercel.app/#work): ODMS, Retail DDS, Buyer Red Line, Classpad, Costco Average Weight and NewKong2.
- [Skills](https://khuongnh-portfolio.vercel.app/#skills): languages, frontend frameworks, testing, cloud, databases and architecture practices.
- [Contact](https://khuongnh-portfolio.vercel.app/#contact): direct email, LinkedIn, Zalo and downloadable resume.

## Professional focus

- Angular and AngularJS application development
- Vue.js 3 and TypeScript application development
- Frontend architecture and reusable component systems
- Responsive, cross-browser enterprise interfaces
- Code review, mentoring and technical frontend leadership
